# OfficeConnectPro

> Step-by-step guides for Workday OfficeConnect

All pages are available as raw Markdown by appending `index.md` to any page URL.


## Get Started

- [What is OfficeConnect?](https://officeconnectpro.com/get-started/what-is-officeconnect/index.md): An overview of OfficeConnect — what it does, who it's for, and how it works with Workday Adaptive Planning.

- [Your First 30 Minutes with Workday OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/get-started/first-30-minutes/index.md): Install, sign in, build your first report, and refresh it — a complete onboarding path from zero to a live Workday OfficeConnect report in half an hour.

- [System Requirements](https://officeconnectpro.com/get-started/system-requirements/index.md): Hardware and software prerequisites before installing OfficeConnect.

- [Install as an End User](https://officeconnectpro.com/get-started/install-end-user/index.md): Install OfficeConnect on your own machine without requiring IT involvement.

- [Set Up Your Reporting Model](https://officeconnectpro.com/get-started/set-up-reporting-model/index.md): Use the Run Set Up Reporting Model task in Workday to configure how OfficeConnect Financials reports are structured.

- [Install as an IT Admin](https://officeconnectpro.com/get-started/install-admin/index.md): Deploy OfficeConnect to multiple users using per-machine installation and group policy or scripts.

- [Check & Update Your Version. ](https://officeconnectpro.com/get-started/check-version/index.md): How to check which version of OfficeConnect you have and update to the latest release.


## Build Reports

- [Interface Tour: The Reporting Pane](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/reporting-pane-tour/index.md): A quick tour of the OfficeConnect interface in Excel — the ribbon tab and the Reporting pane.

- [Add Elements to Rows, Columns & Cells](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/add-elements/index.md): How to drag accounts, time periods, versions, and levels into your Excel report.

- [Work with Time & Contexts](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/time-and-contexts/index.md): Add time periods to your report and use contexts like YTD, QTD, and Beginning Balance.

- [Filter Your Data](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/filter-data/index.md): Apply worksheet and workbook filters to limit which data appears in your report.

- [Cut, Copy & Move Elements](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/cut-copy-move-elements/index.md): How to move OfficeConnect elements within and between rows, columns, and cells.

- [Review & Verify Applied Elements](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/review-applied-elements/index.md): Use the Review tab to see exactly which elements are affecting any cell, row, or column.

- [Workbook & Worksheet Properties](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/workbook-worksheet-properties/index.md): Configure rounding, data clearing, filters, and display options for your reports.

- [Create Repeating Reports](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/repeating-reports/index.md): Automatically generate one copy of a report per department, region, or any other level.

- [Cell Explorer & Drill-Down](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/cell-explorer-drill-down/index.md): Explore the data behind any cell to understand what's driving the numbers.

- [Build Your First OfficeConnect Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/build-first-report/index.md): A complete walkthrough for creating a live Adaptive Planning report in Excel from scratch.

- [Create a Rolling 12-Month Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/rolling-12-month-report/index.md): Build a report whose time columns automatically advance each month without manual updates.

- [Publish a Report to PowerPoint](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/publish-to-powerpoint/index.md): Link a live OfficeConnect Excel report into a PowerPoint deck so slides update with one refresh.

- [Build a Budget vs. Actuals Variance Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/budget-vs-actuals-variance/index.md): Build an OfficeConnect report that shows budget, actuals, and variance side by side — the most common FP&A report in Adaptive Planning.

- [Build a Department P&L Report in OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/department-pl-report/index.md): Build a profit and loss report broken down by department or cost center using OfficeConnect's Level dimension.

- [Build a Year-over-Year Trend Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/year-over-year-trend/index.md): Compare this year's actuals against the prior year month by month using fixed time elements in OfficeConnect.

- [Compare Two Planning Versions Side by Side](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/compare-planning-versions/index.md): Add a second version column to any OfficeConnect report to compare Budget vs. Forecast, two plan iterations, or any two Adaptive Planning versions.

- [Add Headcount Data to a Financial Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/headcount-in-financial-report/index.md): Mix workforce planning metrics (headcount, FTEs, salary cost) with financial accounts in a single OfficeConnect report.

- [Lock and Protect Reports for Distribution](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/lock-protect-reports/index.md): Protect an OfficeConnect workbook for distribution so recipients can't accidentally break formulas — while keeping Refresh working.

- [Set Up Scenario Comparison in OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/scenario-comparison/index.md): Compare planning scenarios side by side in OfficeConnect — useful for showing upside, base case, and downside in the same report.

- [Report in Constant Currency in OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/constant-currency-reporting/index.md): Use a constant currency version in Adaptive Planning to remove FX impact from OfficeConnect reports — useful for multinational teams comparing performance across periods.

- [Build a Formatted Executive Report for Distribution](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/formatted-executive-report/index.md): Build a polished, print-ready executive summary report in OfficeConnect with custom formatting, logos, and page layout — ready to share as PDF or Excel.

- [Work with Custom Dimensions and Attributes in OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/custom-dimensions-attributes/index.md): Report on custom dimensions and attributes defined in your Adaptive Planning model — filter by product line, region, project, or any other custom segment your team uses.

- [Build a Quarterly Board Pack](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/quarterly-board-pack/index.md): Build a multi-sheet OfficeConnect workbook — P&L summary, KPI page, variance commentary, cash snapshot — designed to feed directly into a PowerPoint board deck.

- [Build a KPI Dashboard](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/kpi-dashboard/index.md): Build a single-sheet executive dashboard with six to eight KPI tiles, each pulled live from Adaptive Planning and shown with a prior-period comparison.

- [Build an Operating Expense Waterfall](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/opex-waterfall/index.md): Build a month-over-month OpEx walk showing prior period, adds, reductions, and current period — visualized as an Excel waterfall chart driven by OfficeConnect data.

- [Build a Forecast Accuracy Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/forecast-accuracy/index.md): Build a report that compares a prior forecast version to actuals and calculates absolute error and MAPE by account and period.

- [Build a Workforce Plan with Attrition](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/workforce-with-attrition/index.md): Build a headcount forecast that layers attrition, hiring plan, and fully-loaded cost per FTE — broken out by organizational level with repeating rows.

- [Build a Sales Pipeline-to-Revenue Forecast](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/pipeline-to-revenue/index.md): Build a probability-weighted revenue forecast from pipeline data — stages, probabilities, and expected close dates — using a Pipeline custom dimension in Adaptive Planning.

- [Build a Multi-Entity Consolidations Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/multi-entity-consolidations/index.md): Build a consolidated P&L across legal entities with intercompany eliminations called out as a separate column.

- [Build a Cohort Revenue Retention Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/cohort-retention/index.md): Build a SaaS cohort retention report — revenue by signup cohort, retained revenue by month, and net revenue retention percentage — using repeating rows.

- [Build a Capital Expenditure Tracker](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/capex-tracker/index.md): Build a project-level CapEx tracker with planned spend, actual spend, forecast remaining, and budget variance — driven by a Project Code custom dimension.

- [Build a 13-Week Cash Forecast](https://officeconnectpro.com/build-reports/13-week-cash/index.md): Build a rolling 13-week cash forecast — weekly receipts, disbursements, and ending balance — in the treasury-standard format used for liquidity planning.

## Data Entry & Write-Back

- [Enter Budget Data in Excel with OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/data-entry-writeback/enter-budget-data/index.md): Use Workday OfficeConnect's data entry mode to write budget figures directly from Excel into Adaptive Planning — no need to log in to the Adaptive Planning web interface.

- [Write-Back to Adaptive from Excel: A Complete Guide](https://officeconnectpro.com/data-entry-writeback/writeback-complete-guide/index.md): The 2025R1 write-back feature in Workday OfficeConnect — what it does, who can use it, how to set up a write-back workbook, and how to recover when it fails.

- [Designing Write-Back Permissions for Workday OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/data-entry-writeback/writeback-permissions/index.md): Design Adaptive Planning permissions so Workday OfficeConnect write-back is safe by default — least-privilege roles, version-state gates, and Level-scoped assignments.

- [Common Workday OfficeConnect Write-Back Errors](https://officeconnectpro.com/data-entry-writeback/writeback-errors/index.md): Diagnose and fix the most common Workday OfficeConnect write-back errors — symptoms, root causes, fixes, and how to prevent each from recurring.

- [Auditing Workday OfficeConnect Write-Back Submissions](https://officeconnectpro.com/data-entry-writeback/writeback-audit-trail/index.md): Where Workday OfficeConnect write-back submissions are logged in Adaptive Planning, what's captured, and how to build a SOX-grade review process around the audit trail.

## Troubleshoot & FAQ

- [Fix COM Registration Errors](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/com-registration-error/index.md): How to resolve COM registration errors when installing or updating OfficeConnect.

- [Resolve OfficeConnect Update Errors](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/update-errors/index.md): How to fix errors that occur when updating OfficeConnect to a new version.

- [Task Pane Not Displaying Correctly](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/task-pane-not-displaying/index.md): How to fix the OfficeConnect Reporting pane when it's not showing or displaying incorrectly.

- [Numbers Not Shifting After Inserting Rows](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/numbers-not-shifting/index.md): Why OfficeConnect elements don't move when you insert Excel rows, and how to fix it.

- [Suppress & Hide Zeros and Blanks](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/suppress-zeros-blanks/index.md): How to hide rows with all zeros or blank values in your OfficeConnect workbook.

- [Remove Elements](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/remove-elements/index.md): How to clear OfficeConnect elements from cells, rows, or columns.

- [Change Rounding Settings](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/change-rounding-settings/index.md): How to change how numbers are rounded in OfficeConnect reports.

- [Display Percentage Values Correctly](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/display-percentage-values/index.md): How to prevent rounding from distorting percentage values in OfficeConnect.

- [Create Fixed Date Columns](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/fixed-date-columns/index.md): How to prevent date columns from rolling forward when using relative time elements.

- [Create a Trailing 12-Month Report](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/trailing-12-month-report/index.md): How to build a report that always shows the most recent 12 months of data.

- [Link to External Excel Files](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/link-external-excel-files/index.md): How to link to a plain Excel file from within an OfficeConnect workbook.

- [Run the Troubleshooting Tool](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/troubleshooting-tool/index.md): How to use the OCSystemChecker tool to generate a diagnostic log for Workday Support.

- [Re-Enabling a Disabled OfficeConnect COM Add-in](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/reenable-com-addin/index.md): If Excel disabled Workday OfficeConnect after a crash or stall, the ribbon tab disappears and reinstalling doesn't help — re-enable it from Excel's Disabled Items list.

- [Why Your Refresh Shows 'Contact Technical Support'](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/refresh-contact-support/index.md): The vague "Refresh failed — contact technical support" dialog in Workday OfficeConnect almost always has one of five concrete causes. Diagnose and fix.

- [Fix OfficeConnect Not Refreshing](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/not-refreshing/index.md): OfficeConnect shows stale data or the Refresh button does nothing — causes and step-by-step fixes.

- [Fix Authentication and Token Errors in OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/authentication-token-errors/index.md): OfficeConnect shows authentication errors, token expired messages, or fails to sign in — causes and step-by-step fixes for SSO and token issues.

- [Fix Slow Performance in Large Reports](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/slow-performance/index.md): OfficeConnect refresh takes a long time in large workbooks — diagnose the cause and reduce refresh time.

- [Fix Data Discrepancies Between OfficeConnect and Workday](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/data-discrepancies/index.md): OfficeConnect shows different figures than Workday Report Writer or the Workday UI for the same account and period — common causes and how to diagnose them.

- [Workday OfficeConnect + think-cell: Resolving the Conflict](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/think-cell-conflict/index.md): Workday OfficeConnect and think-cell both use Excel COM subclassing and can interfere with each other — refresh failures, broken charts, Excel crashes. Here's the documented fix.

- [Use OfficeConnect on Mac](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/officeconnect-on-mac/index.md): Install and use Workday OfficeConnect on a Mac with Excel for Mac — what works, what's different from Windows, and how to handle common Mac-specific issues.

- [Workday OfficeConnect on Mac: The VDI Workflow](https://officeconnectpro.com/troubleshoot/mac-vdi-workflow/index.md): Mac users can run the full Windows OfficeConnect experience through a VDI like Azure Virtual Desktop, AWS WorkSpaces, or Parallels — here's the realistic decision guide and setup.


## Performance & Optimization

- [Optimize Performance for Large Models in OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/performance/optimize-performance/index.md): Speed up Workday OfficeConnect reports that are slow to refresh — reduce formula count, use efficient time contexts, and configure workbook settings for large Adaptive Planning models.

- [Workday OfficeConnect Refresh Time Benchmarks](https://officeconnectpro.com/performance/refresh-benchmarks/index.md): Rough benchmarks for what a normal Workday OfficeConnect refresh should take by formula count, what moves the numbers, and how to measure your own workbooks.

- [32-bit vs 64-bit Excel for Workday OfficeConnect](https://officeconnectpro.com/performance/32-vs-64-bit/index.md): Why 64-bit Excel matters for large Workday OfficeConnect workbooks, how to check which version you're running, and how to switch without breaking other add-ins.

- [How to Reduce OfficeConnect Element Count for Faster Refresh](https://officeconnectpro.com/performance/reduce-element-count/index.md): Element count is the single biggest performance lever in Workday OfficeConnect — five concrete tactics to cut it without losing the report you need.

- [Workday OfficeConnect Patterns for Large Repeating Reports](https://officeconnectpro.com/performance/large-repeating-reports/index.md): Patterns and pitfalls for Workday OfficeConnect reports that use repeating rows to generate hundreds of lines from a single element.


## Migration & Comparison

- [Financials vs. Adaptive Planning Data Sources](https://officeconnectpro.com/migration-comparison/financials-vs-adaptive-planning/index.md): Key differences in Workday OfficeConnect behavior depending on whether you're using the Adaptive Planning or Financials data source.

- [OfficeConnect vs Adaptive Web Reports: A Decision Framework](https://officeconnectpro.com/migration-comparison/oc-vs-web-reports/index.md): When to use Workday OfficeConnect vs Workday Adaptive Planning's built-in web reports — a scoring framework with concrete recommendations.


## Reference

- [Workday OfficeConnect Glossary](https://officeconnectpro.com/reference/glossary/index.md): Alphabetical reference for every Workday OfficeConnect term — elements, filters, contexts, write-back, tenants, and more.

- [OfficeConnect Formula Reference](https://officeconnectpro.com/reference/formula-reference/index.md): What's actually inside a Workday OfficeConnect cell — formula structure, components, and how to read it.

- [Element Types Reference](https://officeconnectpro.com/reference/element-types/index.md): Every element type you can drag from the Workday OfficeConnect Reporting pane, what it represents, and where it lives in each data source.

## What's New

- [What's New in Workday OfficeConnect 2026R1](https://officeconnectpro.com/whats-new/2026r1/index.md): Workday OfficeConnect 2026R1 (released March 14, 2026) introduces View By in the ribbon, personal what-if scenarios for end users, and the latest forced-upgrade prompt at sign-in.

- [View By — Open Cell Data in a New Sheet (2026R1)](https://officeconnectpro.com/whats-new/2026r1-view-by/index.md): The 2026R1 View By ribbon command opens the data behind any Workday OfficeConnect cell in a separate worksheet so you can slice and filter without breaking your main report.

- [Personal What-If Scenarios (2026R1)](https://officeconnectpro.com/whats-new/2026r1-personal-scenarios/index.md): Workday OfficeConnect 2026R1 lets end users create personal what-if scenarios without involving an Adaptive Planning admin — scoped to the individual, branched from a parent version, and invisible to others.
